locked_conventions.arithmetic: finite fixtures use exact reduced rationals; logarithms, pi, square roots, pole projections, and breakpoint determinants use outward mpmath.iv intervals; binary64 JSON numbers are forbidden
locked_conventions.artifact_scope: exact finite-dimensional regressions and outward source-formula intervals, not a physical prolate-Weil matrix, matched coframe, or asymptotic theorem
locked_conventions.fourier_sign: fhat(t)=integral f(x)*exp(-i*t*x)dx with Plancherel measure dt/(2*pi)
locked_conventions.inversion: J is reflection in logarithmic coordinates; Fourier residue classes are not substituted for inversion parity
locked_conventions.matched_schedule: lambda=p/2 for odd p>=5 and N=ceil(lambda^2)=(p^2+3)/4; floor(lambda^2)=N-1
locked_conventions.physical_interval: I_lambda=[-log(lambda),log(lambda)] with Lebesgue measure in logarithmic coordinates, equivalently du/u on [lambda^(-1),lambda]
locked_conventions.pole_signs: p_plus(x)=cosh(x/2) is positive rank one and p_minus(x)=sinh(x/2) is negative rank one in the complete signed high operator
locked_conventions.prime_endpoint: every prime power n<=lambda^2 is retained; this cutoff is distinct from the arithmetic index a<=floor(lambda^2)
locked_conventions.source_interval: [-lambda,lambda] with Lebesgue measure and zero extension; every prolate source retains its zero-Lebesgue-integral source normalization and full source Gram
locked_conventions.strictness: equality at a target floor, rank-one load one, zero determinant, or nonpositive reserve is rejected

locked_formulas.moment_floor: if A<=M*I and trace((M*I-A)^r)<=d*(M-nu*L)^r then lambda_min(A)>=M-d^(1/r)*(M-nu*L)
locked_formulas.moment_threshold: a strict floor mu*L requires r>log(d)/log((M-mu*L)/(M-nu*L)); equality is rejected
locked_formulas.parity_projection: h_j=(I-P_(N,s))*q_j retains every interior jump of q_j and obeys P_(N,s)*h_j=0 by idempotence
locked_formulas.positive_pole_centered: for A_plus=alpha*L*I+P*|u><u| the sharp centered-moment bound equals alpha*L-P*(d-2)/d at every order
